purpose: Read-only recovery inspection after core-02 host crash; no process signaling

attribution.basis: Core run started at 06:33:02 local; crash was after source native reap and before dependent activation. No retained launch PID ties candidate 2144 conclusively to that dependent.

observations.action: repeated same read-only inventory outside automation sandbox

source_findings.publication: ActorScheduler computes continuousCutoff(afterMs: input.lifetimeMs), assigns actorInput.lifetimeCutoffTicks before ActorSession writes the shared header.
source_findings.worker_check: Worker translates absolute continuous ticks relative to origin. wait_for_activation checks cutoff on each sample, publishes PW_FAILURE_LIFETIME_CUTOFF and exits through publish_done_and_exit.
source_findings.inference: Candidate disappearance is consistent with the 180-second lifetime cutoff; no indefinite parked-loop defect established.

limits: Process-table absence is a current absence observation, not an owned wait/reap result or proof that the lifetime cutoff caused departure. No artifact or cleanup ownership record was deleted.
